description:
Extend the Docker Compose project at `/home/ga/s3-project` to include a local MinIO service (S3 compatible) and configure the Flask application to use it. 

Requirements:
1. Add a MinIO service to `docker-compose.yml` (image: `minio/minio`, command: `server /data --console-address ":9001"`).
2. Configure the `web` service with environment variables `S3_ENDPOINT_URL`, `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, and `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` to point to the local MinIO service.
3. Implement a mechanism to AUTOMATICALLY create a bucket named `company-assets` when the stack starts (e.g., using a create-bucket container/script, or a volume mapping approach). The bucket MUST exist after `docker compose up` without manual intervention.
4. Ensure the application can upload files. The app is accessible at http://localhost:5000.

Note: The Flask app uses `boto3` and expects the bucket to exist. Credentials can be set to any secure values (e.g., minioadmin/minioadmin).
